technology_name: Recirculatory Aquaculture System (RAS) with Aquaponics & MBBR
problem_solved: High water consumption, land constraints, and severe organic waste pollution associated with traditional open-pond fish farming and conventional agriculture.
description: A deployable, closed-loop Recirculatory Aquaculture System (RAS) integrated with Aquaponics and Moving Bed Bio-Reactor (MBBR) technology. The system pumps nutrient-rich wastewater from high-density fish tanks into soilless vegetable grow beds, where plants naturally filter the water before it recirculates (saving 90% of water). The infrastructure includes a 2 m³ biogas unit that digests sludge to produce cooking gas, and an optional greywater-only variant for urban environments.
applications:
• Turnkey commercial urban farming and rooftop agriculture installations

• High-density organic fish and vegetable production for local markets

• Institutional deployment for schools, eco-resorts, and community housing

• Greywater recycling and decentralized municipal waste-to-value systems
